title: Topkey vs Clearing
summary: Compare Topkey and Clearing for vacation rental accounting. See the difference in expense management, bill pay, Airbnb reconciliation, owner statements and integrations.
body_markdown:
### What's the difference between Topkey and Clearing?


Clearing is built around revenue reconciliation and owner statements. Topkey covers both and adds enterprise-grade expense management and bill pay, a direct Airbnb integration, more PMS and accounting integrations, and a dedicated financial consultant who helps your team close the books.


### What can Topkey do that Clearing can't?


Topkey offers a direct Airbnb integration, bill pay that reads invoices with AI, approval workflows by rule, inventory management, expenses pushed to your PMS as owner charges, sync with Track Hospitality, BrightSide and Feather, sync with QuickBooks Desktop, Xero, NetSuite and Sage Intacct, and an American Express® partnership.


### Does Clearing integrate directly with Airbnb?


No. Clearing's integrations page doesn't list Airbnb, Vrbo or Booking.com. Topkey connects directly to Airbnb and matches each payout to its reservation.


### Which accounting software does Topkey work with?


QuickBooks Online, QuickBooks Desktop, Xero, NetSuite and Sage Intacct. Clearing says QuickBooks Online is its only accounting integration.


### Which PMSs does Topkey work with?


Guesty, Hostaway, Hostfully, OwnerRez, Track Hospitality, BrightSide, Feather, Streamline, Hospitable and more. See the full list on the[integrations page](https://topkey.io/integrations) .


### Does Topkey have trust accounting, owner statements and P&L reports?


Yes. Topkey includes trust accounting with a trust ledger and period close, owner statements built from your PMS data, and P&L and cash flow reports.


### Does Topkey calculate commission automatically?


Yes. Each owner contract sets percentage commissions, channel-specific rates and flat management fees, and Topkey calculates commission and statement amounts from your PMS reservations.


### Does Topkey have an owner portal?


Yes. You invite owners from their owner record, and they log in to view and download their finalized statements by property.


### Is Topkey built for large property management companies?


Yes. Topkey supports multiple entities, approval workflows, roles and permissions, and sync with NetSuite and Sage Intacct, with a dedicated financial consultant for your team. More than 350 property managers run on Topkey across 52,000+ properties.


### Can I switch from Clearing to Topkey mid-year?


Yes. We handle most of the setup, you run one month in both systems, and you send your first Topkey statements the month after.
